system.description: Through devotion to Entelechy, this Brujah has more fully integrated her awareness of Beast and Self. She cannot resist the call of frenzy any better than her less disciplined kin, but can briefly steer its direction. The player spends a Willpower point and rolls Self-Control or Instincts at one difficulty higher than the original difficulty to resist frenzy; for each success, the character may control her actions for one turn while frenzied.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Three: Zealots
